title: Narrow substring append
summary: Recovered 0x4420b0 (178 bytes) as a genuine thiscall member on the 24-byte narrow string: unsigned position check, clipped count, strict maximum-length check, optional capacity preparation, post-preparation storage resolution, memcpy append, length and terminator update. Direct immutable PE disassembly agrees with accepted evidence. Callers 0x4421b4 and 0x4421ca route self interior pointers through this method; 0x4b2e18 passes position zero and UINT_MAX count. Capacity, copy and error services remain explicit external bindings.
test_description: GCC freestanding i386 differential tests call the original assigned method directly with all inline/heap source-destination combinations, inline lengths 0..15 and heap lengths 0..30 in steps of 3, plus exact heap capacity 63, every valid source position, counts 0,1,3,15,UINT_MAX, and self-subranges. Cases stay within existing capacity. Recovered preparation adapter invokes accepted original preparation; original copy thunk uses the exact four-byte test IAT memcpy callback. Full guarded object and backing comparisons verify length, capacity, terminator, unchanged storage bytes, source immutability and return identity; preparation invocation count and arguments checked. Explicit FS setup must succeed and head restoration is checked after original calls. Local differential run passed; linked reference spans (178,174,6 bytes) compared exactly with immutable Game.exe. Implementation compiled with supplied VS2013 under O1, O2 and O2 /Oy-.
known_limits: Growth/allocation, exception dispatch and error throwing are external dependencies and are not executed in these normal-path tests.
False preparation return is retained in source but unreachable for valid nonempty no-growth test inputs.
Copy uses the original memcpy contract; malformed objects and overlapping distinct heap views are not given invented semantics.
This is readable semantic recovery, with no claim of matching compiled bytes.
